title: Summary currency: refresh the stale "dynamic only on a home-amount roll-up" wording left after #35045
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

Follow-up from the contract review of PR #35387 (comment 7003851180, nits N2–N4). That PR lets a `dynamic` summary roll up any plain `dynamic` child amount, not only a stored home amount. Behaviour is right; three pieces of text still describe the old, narrower rule.

## What to change
- **N2** — `packages/spec/src/data/record-currency-path.ts` module header ends "Messages only and two predicates". It now exports three (`isTenantCurrencyAmount` added).
- **N3** — the fallback arm of the (d) refusal, reached by a `currency` child whose config is neither `dynamic` nor a well-formed `record` / `fixed` (e.g. a stored `fixed` row with no code), reads "is a 'currency' field, not a `currency` field in `dynamic` mode". True, but it does not say what is wrong with the field. Name the missing piece.
- **N4** — `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.summary-dynamic-currency-rollup-home-amount-judged-as-served.ts` still says a `dynamic` summary "is right only for a roll-up of a stored home amount", and its acceptance step "save one over another child field and confirm 422" no longer holds for a plain `dynamic` amount. The comments in `ui/packages/fields/src/currency.ts`, `index.tsx` and `widgets/SummaryField.tsx` are narrow in the same way.

Out of scope: the skills text (eval 20 in `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` and `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md:179-184`). That is a governed path; seat 5 files it.

## Done when
The three places state the admitted set as the doors enforce it (any `currency` child in `dynamic` mode); the N3 message names the defect; no accept-set change (`Clause-②: no`).

## Grade
p3 · area:data · domain:spec. Text only; no customer sees a wrong result. Rides a same-file p2 PR, not dispatched alone.
